landing.meta.title: TAKKA - Choose a university with help from real students
landing.meta.description: TAKKA connects prospective students with current university students.
landing.meta.ogTitle: TAKKA - University discovery through student experience
landing.meta.ogDescription: Explore universities through the experiences of the people who actually study there.
landing.heading: Choose your university through the students who study there.
landing.subheading: Rankings and brochures do not tell you what first year really feels like. TAKKA connects you with current students so you can ask questions before you decide.
landing.heroAlt: Students talking on a university campus lawn
landing.step.explore.title: Explore universities
landing.step.explore.text: Browse clean profiles with departments, campuses, facilities and student ratings.
landing.step.ask.title: Ask real students
landing.step.ask.text: Post a question and get answers from people currently studying in that department.
landing.step.decide.title: Decide with confidence
landing.step.decide.text: Compare honest experiences instead of brochures, then chat one-to-one before you apply.
landing.cta.heading: From not knowing which university to choose, to a confident decision.
landing.footer: TAKKA · A student community for university discovery
landing.trust: Verified students from universities across Myanmar
landing.benefits.heading: Because choosing a university shouldn't be this complicated
landing.benefits.text: We went through the same guesswork ourselves, so we built a simpler way to find out what a place is really like.
landing.benefit.oneplace.title: One place for everything
landing.benefit.oneplace.text: Departments, campuses, questions and student posts sit in one profile instead of scattered across group chats.
landing.benefit.honest.title: Answers, not brochures
landing.benefit.honest.text: Ask about workload, teaching or hostel life and hear it from someone sitting in that lecture hall this semester.
landing.benefit.verified.title: A community you can trust
landing.benefit.verified.text: Student accounts are checked against their university, so you know who is actually answering you.
landing.marquee.heading: For everyone choosing a course
landing.walkthrough.heading: We've done the hard part, now it's your turn to choose
landing.walkthrough.text: Whether you are picking a university or already studying at one, everything is built to flow.
landing.student.verify.title: Verify your place
landing.student.verify.text: Confirm your university and department once, and your answers carry a verified badge from then on.
landing.student.share.title: Share what it is really like
landing.student.share.text: Post about lectures, hostels, clubs and exams for the people deciding right now.
landing.student.answer.title: Answer the next intake
landing.student.answer.text: Reply to questions about your department and help someone choose with their eyes open.
landing.faq.heading: Questions, answered
landing.faq.free.a: Yes. Browsing universities, asking questions and messaging students are all free for everyone.
landing.faq.who.a: Current students at the university you asked about. Verified accounts carry a badge so you can tell them apart.
landing.faq.verify.a: A student submits their university and department, and an administrator checks it before the badge is granted.
landing.faq.join.q: Do I need to be a student to join?
landing.faq.join.a: No. TAKKA is built for people who have not chosen a university yet, as much as for those already studying.
landing.faq.language.q: Can I use TAKKA in Burmese?
landing.faq.language.a: Yes. Switch between English and Burmese at any time, and your choice is remembered on your next visit.
